relationship_to_v3: FRESH preregistration, not an amendment. v3 was pinned to mode: dspark and never issued a generation request -- its identity gate refused at the door when the operator intentionally switched to baseline. v3 is retained unedited. Its ~1,468 s counterfactual is void: it assumed dspark AND a full-recompute prefill that RECONCILIATION.md shows did not happen.

the_condition.speculative_decoding: OFF, deliberately, on the operator's recommendation for this workload
the_condition.reasoning_effort: low (server-set); not specifiable from this client
the_condition.why_baseline: This load is deep post-tool-result reasoning, where the operator measures dspark at 0.58x baseline (9.5 vs 16.5 tok/s). Speculative decoding wins only on low-entropy code, where it is 36.4 vs 28.7 the other way.

do_not_re_measure_baseline_vs_dspark.instruction: This experiment does NOT compare baseline against dspark, and must not be read as doing so.
do_not_re_measure_baseline_vs_dspark.reason: The operator has decided it and owns the decision. Re-deriving it would spend their server time on a settled question, and a shallow prompt gives the opposite answer -- a trap they hit once themselves.

backend_identity_gate.now_two_checks: the /v1/models listing hash AND the /health hash. Both must pass; either failure refuses the trial before any request.
backend_identity_gate.why_both: The listing caught the 2026-08-19 weights change. /health is what reports the decode path -- mode, drafter, max_draft, reasoning_effort, context_window, max_output_tokens -- none of which appears in the echoed response.model field that the original pin asserted on.
backend_identity_gate.verified_before_freezing: both hashes computed from the live endpoints and the gate re-run to a pass

counterfactual_on_record_before_the_tria.derivation: From skill-1's own measured decomposition: deep calls 14,435 output tokens at 4.5 tok/s under dspark, scaled by the operator's 1.74x baseline advantage to 7.8 tok/s = 1,847 s; shallow calls unchanged at 1,170 s.
counterfactual_on_record_before_the_tria.supersedes: the v3 figure of ~1,468 s, which assumed dspark and a full-recompute prefill that did not happen
counterfactual_on_record_before_the_tria.bounds: Upper bound in one respect: if the operator's cache fix credits more than skill-1 already got, the shallow term shrinks. Unbounded in another: if a trial reasons more than skill-1 did, the deep term grows without limit -- that is the term that hit the cap.
counterfactual_on_record_before_the_tria.how_it_will_be_judged: Reported against each completed trial's elapsed time, without adjustment.

deliberately_NOT_changed.syn_api_surface: not given to either arm; noskill-1 reached 120/120 without it
deliberately_NOT_changed.forced_transition: not added; noskill-1 made the transition unaided

not_poolable: Not with m7, not with m8, not with v2's two trials (broken cache, dspark). Nor the reverse. Different serving implementation, quantization, decode path and cache behaviour.

in_flight_cache_check.method: ratio = elapsed / (summed distinct per-turn input_tokens / 311 tok/s); cache_credited below 0.6
in_flight_cache_check.important_qualification_added_after_v3: RECONCILIATION.md shows this ratio was NOT a clean cache detector for skill-1: 12 of its 15 calls completed faster than a full recompute, so the cache was crediting even though skill-1 scored 1.323 on this ratio. The ratio is therefore recorded as a DIAGNOSTIC, and a high value triggers a per-call check of whether any call beat its own full-recompute time before the series is stopped.
in_flight_cache_check.enforcement: A cache_NOT_credited verdict stops the series only after the per-call check confirms no call beat its full-recompute time. Otherwise it is recorded and the series continues.

truncated_tail_watch.symptom: tails cut mid-sentence or with an unclosed code block; the operator's local patch can be lost SILENTLY on a package update
truncated_tail_watch.handling: a hit STOPS the series; no retry; record time, approximate token count, client

operating_agreement.experiment_window: The operator has been given a 3-4 hour window for this run and will freeze configuration during it. Announced windows are now the norm; the two mid-experiment backend changes are why.

primary_output_is_descriptive.statement: Per-trial records: the three verdicts, what the loop did, elapsed against the counterfactual. NOT an arm comparison.
primary_output_is_descriptive.comparative_claims: Nothing is ever ACCEPTED. Complete separation (3/3 vs 0/3) is SUGGESTIVE only; anything less is noise, stated in advance.

half_edited_tree_rule: How the loop ended is classified BEFORE its code is looked at, and wins. exit 124 -> loop_incomplete_timeout; other non-zero -> loop_incomplete_error. Excluded from compiles/tests_pass tallies with the exclusion reported. v2's noskill-1 was loop_incomplete_timeout yet compiled and passed 120/120; the code state is reported alongside, never hidden by, the verdict.
stopping_rules: One request in flight at any time.
No retry of any trial, for any reason.
Any upstream failure stops the series; record time, approximate token count, client, and completed trials per arm.
Either identity gate failure refuses the trial and stops the series (exit 66), before any request.
A truncated-tail signature stops the series (exit 68).
Per-trial wall-clock cap 5,400 s; hitting it is loop_incomplete_timeout and does not by itself stop the series.
Maximum 6 trials. A trial lost upstream is excluded and NOT replaced.
Every halt uses scripts/halt.sh, verified by an untruncated count.
preservation: Each trial copied into the repository as it completes, never batched.
